notes.title: V0.1.0 Snowfield pass ready, start to Armon, bugfixes and new main theme!
notes.content:
- The snowfield pass is now [b]completely done[/b] and the start of armon is set. 
- There is also a [b]new main theme[/b] available in the game soon!
- You can now sleep and [b]rest in your own bed[/b] (thx to [b]@gldpoet[/b])

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
The villagers of Artcaster decorated the cities for [b]Halloween[/b] and the mysterious house is now opened!
The house seems to be harmless but you have to search under every stone and every box to discover the secret!
